content:
sam: Noticed a parity gap: REST /v1/rerank accepts "candidate_weights" array to bias score aggregation, but python SDK v1.3.0 silently drops it and returns uniform scores. Quick repro: curl vs sdk.
jamie: Oof. Can you paste the minimal repro?
sam: curl I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"query":"find best","candidates":["a","b","c"],"candidate_weights":[0.1,0.7,0.2],"method":"weighted_avg"}'
```
jamie: And the python snippet?
sam: Python SDK call:
```python
from redwood import Redwood
c = Redwood(api_key=TOKEN)
resp = c.rerank.create(query='find best', candidates=['a','b','c'], candidate_weights=[0.1,0.7,0.2], method='weighted_avg')
print(resp.scores)
```
rachel: What do the responses look like?
sam: curl returns ranking biased to candidate 2 as expected. SDK returns almost-uniform scores. No error, just different numbers.
infra: Are there differences in the payload sent? Could be a serializer naming mismatch (snake_case vs camelCase) or the SDK may be nesting candidate_weights under options.
sam: I dumped the SDK HTTP body from a proxy. SDK sends:
```json
{"query":"find best","candidates":["a","b","c"],"candidateWeights":[0.1,0.7,0.2],"method":"weighted_avg"}
```
jamie: Ah there it is: SDK snake_to_camel is doing candidateWeights while REST expects candidate_weights (snake_case). Public gateway accepts both but the rerank service in private and dedicated only honors exact field names for performance, dropping unknown fields. Hence weights ignored.
rachel: Interesting. So two problems: (1) SDK normalizer changed field casing for this endpoint, and (2) the service shouldn't silently ignore weights without warning. We should add a validation error in the service or accept both variants.
sam: Agreed. Impact: sample-app uses SDK and downstream ranking tuned weights appear to be ineffective in private deployments. Several customers reported "model suddenly changed".
jamie: Action items: 1) Patch SDK serialiser to preserve original field name for rerank endpoints (fast patch). 2) Add server-side strict schema error to return 400 when unknown critical fields are dropped (infra). 3) Add an E2E test comparing rest vs sdk payloads and scores (devex).
infra: I'll add a quick flag to the rerank service to enable strict-validation in private/dedicated. Won't flip it on globally until we ship SDK fix.
devex-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/9001 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4592 for server validation.
rachel: Also update the quickstart docs to show that for rerank, SDK call should use request_body override until patch is out: `c.rerank.create(request_body={...})` to control exact field names. Add a note in the SDK changelog.
sam: Thanks. I'll open a minimal PR for the serializer fix and include a test that asserts candidate_weights field appears verbatim in outgoing JSON.
jamie: Assigning to sam for SDK PR, infra for service flag. We'll follow up in this thread when canary deployed.
